title: Coherence-gated quantum devices via real-time weak measurement
summary: Single-photon routers in cavity and circuit QED direct photons by the qubit's energy eigenstate -- a projective decision that destroys coherence. We propose a different primitive: coherence-gated routing, where the decision depends on the magnitude of the qubit's quantum coherence, estimated in real time from simultaneous weak measurements of $σ_x$ and $σ_z$. A photon is accepted if the coherence score $S(T) = \sqrt{\langleσ_x\rangle_c^2 + \langleσ_y\rangle_c^2}$, extracted from the conditional density matrix via the stochastic master equation, exceeds a tunable threshold $S_{\mathrm{th}}$.…
